question: In Cricket, which of the following is NOT a bowl type of Fast bowling?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chinaman**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Chinaman bowling** is a type of spin bowling, not fast bowling. It is typically delivered by a left-arm unorthodox spinner who spins the ball away from a right-handed batsman. 
• Fast bowling includes deliveries like **Bouncer, Leg Cutter, In-Swinger**, and other variations that rely on speed and seam movement. 
• **Bouncer:** A short-pitched delivery aimed at the batsman’s chest or head area, used to intimidate or induce mistakes. It is a fast bowling technique. 
• **Leg Cutter:** A fast bowler’s delivery that moves away from the batsman after pitching, achieved by spinning the ball slightly with the fingers. 
• **In-Swinger:** A fast bowler’s delivery that moves in towards the batsman after pitching, achieved by angling the seam towards the batter. 
• **Chinaman:** A slower spin bowling technique us
